projects.title: Infrastructure lab
projects.line: A small company built from scratch: AD/DC identity, segmented network, IPFire perimeter firewall and a SIEM correlating events, all virtualized on Proxmox. Kali Linux checks that the rules hold.

projects.title: AquaSense IoT
projects.line: An ESP32 measures 7 water parameters, drives the solar collector pump and publishes over MQTT/TLS to a React dashboard and an Alexa skill. Delivered to Invivio Tecnologia by a team of three.

projects.title: Electronic safe
projects.line: One safe ported to Arduino UNO, Raspberry Pi Pico (MicroPython) and ESP32: I²C LCD, 3×4 keypad, servo and the password kept in NVS. The LCD was even driven by bit-banging.
projects.credit: based on Uri Shaked's open-source safe

projects.title: CPTM assets
projects.line: Spring Boot REST API for trains, stations and lines: 14 endpoints across 9 controllers, operational statistics and 10 JUnit test classes. Delivered to CPTM.

portfolio_card.title: Portifolio
portfolio_card.line: The site is the demo: an explorable pixel-art room with a 3D TV in hand-written WebGL, secret passages, minigames, 51 achievements and a recruiter mode for when you're in a hurry.
